aboutHeading: Property Maintenance Across Melbourne from Kealba
aboutSubheading: Local team, no subcontractors, always available
aboutText: Property Fixers Melbourne is proudly based in Kealba and serves suburbs across Greater Melbourne's inner city, eastern suburbs, bayside, north, and west. Our own team of reliable tradesmen — we never use subcontractors — delivers prompt, professional service for everything from minor repairs to full renovations. With end-to-end project management, transparent pricing, and 24-hour availability, we make property maintenance simple and stress-free for homeowners and businesses alike.

servicesText: We don't use subcontractors — our own team of reliable tradesmen handles everything from urgent repairs and general maintenance to complete renovations and property upgrades. With transparent pricing and dedicated project management, we keep things simple.

reviews.text: Property Fixers Melbourne completely renovated our kitchen and the results were fantastic. The end-to-end project management meant I did not have to worry about a thing. The team was punctual and professional throughout. Cannot recommend them enough.
reviews.name: Jake Morrison

reviews.text: We called Property Fixers for urgent plumbing and electrical repairs at our cafe in Melbourne's west. They responded within hours and had everything fixed the same day. Reliable service exactly when you need it most.
reviews.name: Sarah Thompson

reviews.text: Property Fixers handled a full roof replacement and fencing job for one of our rental properties. The work was completed on time, on budget, and to a high standard. We now use them for all our property maintenance.
reviews.name: David Chen
